content:
Looking at the graph, f(x) = ln(x) passes through (1, 0) and reaches about 2.1 at x = 8.

The curve g has the same shape but every point is raised: it passes through (1, 4) and reaches about 6.1 at x = 8 (since ln(8) ≈ 2.08, and 2.08 + 4 ≈ 6.08). At x = e, f = 1 while g = 5.

So g is f shifted vertically up by 4 units: g(x) = ln(x) + 4.

\boxed{g(x) = \ln(x) + 4}
